_comment: Add new tools here. Each tool needs: name, category, description, url. Category must match one of: systems-linux, embedded-automotive, networking-protocols, development-tools

tools.name: Linux Kernel Explorer
tools.description: Browse and search Linux kernel source code with cross-references and documentation links.

tools.name: Syscall Reference
tools.description: Interactive Linux syscall reference with argument details, return values, and examples.

tools.name: ELF Inspector
tools.description: Parse and visualize ELF binary headers, sections, and symbol tables in the browser.

tools.name: Memory Map Viewer
tools.description: Visualize /proc/maps and linker script memory layouts for running processes.

tools.name: CAN Bus Analyzer
tools.description: Decode and analyze CAN bus frames with DBC file support and signal plotting.

tools.name: UDS Protocol Tool
tools.description: Build, send, and decode UDS (ISO 14229) diagnostic messages interactively.

tools.name: AUTOSAR Config Editor
tools.description: Edit and validate AUTOSAR ARXML configuration files with schema-aware suggestions.

tools.name: Embedded Bit-field Calculator
tools.description: Define register bit-fields, compute masks, and generate C macros automatically.

tools.name: Wireshark Filter Builder
tools.description: Build complex Wireshark/tshark display filters with syntax highlighting and validation.

tools.name: IP Subnet Calculator
tools.description: Calculate subnets, CIDR notation, broadcast addresses, and host ranges instantly.

tools.name: MQTT Explorer
tools.description: Connect to MQTT brokers, subscribe to topics, and visualize message payloads.

tools.name: Protocol Buffer Decoder
tools.description: Decode raw protobuf bytes using a .proto schema, with field-level inspection.

tools.name: Makefile Generator
tools.description: Generate cross-platform Makefiles for C/C++ projects with configurable flags and targets.

tools.name: GDB Command Reference
tools.description: Searchable GDB command reference with examples, tips, and pretty-printer snippets.

tools.name: CMake Configurator
tools.description: Interactively compose CMakeLists.txt files with target definitions and package discovery.

tools.name: Compiler Explorer Lite
tools.description: Compile small C/C++ snippets and inspect assembly output, flags, and optimization results.
